note: Inequality reversed. The summand H^{q-2j}(X,ℤ_ℓ(-j)) goes to f^*(τ) ∧ u^j, which lies in F^{q-2j} of the decreasing Leray filtration (f^*(τ) in F^{q-2j}, u^j in F^0).
